fieldValues.title: How does an exercise reach a session without flooding the desk?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised as an open question in Research (Open exercises), 2026-10-30, and turned into an exercise so options are explored before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Only exercises in the owner's log reach the session (today's rule); everything else stays in Research.
- B. An exercise reaches the session when an option is ready to propose.
- C. The session sees a count and a list, and takes up one or two by choice.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: How many exercises the owner can take up in one session, and which got lost.
fieldValues.next_action: Track which of today's exercises the owner opens over the next weeks.
